scope: Implementing-agent automated validation of SDK, browser/read interfaces, oracle services and owned local lifecycle fixtures. Real leveraged closure and real-source run evidence are separate artifacts.

source.working_tree: Dirty implementation under review; captured before the coordinating commit.
source.hash_method: SHA-256 of checked-in or pending source/config/test/fixture bytes with CRLF replaced by LF, with no other normalization. Raw logs and the runner ledger use byte-exact SHA-256.
source.path_convention: ${REPOSITORY_ROOT} replaces the checkout prefix in recorded argv/cwd. Forward slashes are used for portability; the original argv remains in the byte-hashed ledger.

forge.path_precedence: Pinned Foundry directory prepended to PATH

toolchain.execution: SDK/services runner attempts were serial. Supplemental E2E22/typecheck attempts 33-34 ran concurrently with each other and read-only preflight. Supplemental E2E24/typecheck attempts 53-54 ran serially, supplied by the oracle agent. Both supplemental groups used Bun1.3.13 with --no-env-file, inherited FOUNDRY_PROFILE was not attested, and neither invoked Forge. Exact argv/log metadata and filesystem-only timestamps are retained. Forge/ABI/deployment lane serialized with the other integration agents.

environment.scope: Serial SDK/services runner attempts; supplemental oracle-agent attempts 33-34 and 53-54 are described separately.
environment.fork_child_policy: OS/toolchain allowlist plus explicit fixture parameters; credential and RPC overrides rejected, ETH_RPC_URL/RPC_URL/FOUNDRY_ETH_RPC_URL forced to the owned loopback URL, Forge --no-proxy.

summary.counting_policy: Use the latest successful full command per package/script. Exclude superseded reruns and the focused fork-safety run from the normal total. Keeper test/fork also selects five safety guards already counted in its unit suite; only its six onchain scenarios add to the fourteen fork scenarios.

controls: Refuse occupied ports before any child spawn or RPC use.
Require alive owned child, Anvil client identity and chain 31337 before transactions.
Create a unique empty run directory, retain prior logs/manifests/receipts and never recursively remove existing evidence.
Await owned Anvil child exit during teardown; preserve failed evidence.

scenarios: keeper on a local deploy > L1 path: halt, request, assert, finalize → Final YES (ASSERTED_TRUE)
keeper on a local deploy > rejection: dispute, sync, DVM says false, finalize → Review; open at retryOpensAt
keeper on a local deploy > no answer: request, escalate, open, then void at the deadline → Final INVALID (VOID_DEADLINE)
keeper on a local deploy > void at the deadline with a disputed assertion the DVM never answers → Final INVALID, bond stuck
keeper on a local deploy > two instances, the second offset (production): each job is sent once, the other sees it stale
keeper on a local deploy > two instances with no offset: duplicates may both land, as no-ops, never reverts
panel runner on a local deploy > after T, clean: the signed payload is accepted and the market goes to Review
panel runner on a local deploy > after T, flagged snapshot: accepted with flags = 1, the market goes to Review
panel runner on a local deploy > before T, clean early check: the market returns to None
panel runner on a local deploy > before T, flagged early check: the market goes to EarlyReview
watchdog on a local deploy > a wrong Layer 1 proposal is disputed with the float inside liveness
watchdog on a local deploy > a stopped heartbeat moves L1 liveness to the reviewed value
committee console on a local deploy > Review: a 2-of-3 proposal with an added source is accepted by the oracle
committee console on a local deploy > EarlyReview: the proposal is accepted and halts the market at its block

local_fork_safety.boundary: These fourteen oracle lifecycle/control scenarios use the existing explicit test venue/factory fixtures and stored provider vectors. They do not establish leveraged settlement, external adjudication or paid provider correctness.

frontend_and_sdk_coverage: Concrete engine/factory/vault ABIs and browser-safe typed transaction builders; owner and wallet-network mismatch rejection.
Generic sanitized versioned manifest and block-pinned arbitrary-owner reads, checked deployment/listing identities, bounded event pagination.
Unavailable/stale prices remain unavailable; claimability requires completed preparation and positive claim amount.
Independent local SDK signer preparation/claim receipt auditing is covered by separate deterministic runner evidence; this artifact does not substitute unit tests for those receipts.
Live owner state auditor checks canonical block-pinned positions/cash/coverage, funding and actual order/Fill calldata, valid post-fill sample capture and cross-role receipt deduplication.

Deployment preparation checks reciprocal registry/treasury/oracle/token/governance identity before producing unsigned transactions; matching bindings and all five mismatch paths are covered with mocked reads.

Optional rollover helper pins epoch/work/cursor, measures current bounded gas with20%plus10000 margin, preserves exact pending transaction bytes/finality and validates actual helper progress events. An opaque nested RPC code3/data0x on a larger candidate may stop optimization only after a smaller measured fit; searchStop retains the candidate and reason, final exact simulation/race checks remain mandatory, and no OOG classification is inferred. Unit tests do not establish real-source or1024-owner timing.

changes_after_process_launch: Require valid observation capture time at or after the fill as well as a later receipt block.
Use a unique pauseRequestId and require matching samplingPauseRequestId after pending sampler work drains.

After successful maker/seal history, arm a minimum-capture pause before the bootstrap epoch boundary, retain that sealed observation and require sufficient unchanged protocol carry before beginning rollover.

Publisher may overlap genuine strictly-newer INDEX publication with a canonically mined sampler capture while its signed journal still awaits finality. New sampling, valid-sample counting and pause acknowledgement remain finalized-only; pricefeed regressions are recorded separately.
live_actor_hardening_revision.execution_boundary: The prior run loaded the earlier actor/publisher revisions and did not reach normal pricing at its first mature rollover because the sealed capture expired during the sweep. No completed live proof is claimed here. The final hardening changes were covered by regressions and require a separate fresh run; they are not claimed to have executed in the prior run. The independent canonical auditor already required valid capture after the fill, and the contract book revision invalidates earlier captures.

rollover_budget.arming: After durable successful maker/seal history, during the last 30 seconds request minimumCaptureTime=epochEnd-15. Wait is bounded by epochEnd, 35 seconds, and the original activation deadline. Missing/stale evidence fails explicitly; existing signed work/sweeps reconcile, and an initial epoch without successful maker/seal history can advance without claiming leverage.

superseded_armed_diagnostic.reason: Observed capture-to-seal lag plus four-block finality left inadequate acknowledgement scheduling margin. The run was gracefully retired with journals preserved before replacement using reviewed canonical capture/INDEX overlap.
superseded_armed_diagnostic.fresh_live_proof: Required separately; unit tests and interface review do not establish timing success.

workflow_restart_limits.supported: Persist exact signed pending transaction bytes before broadcast; reconcile that hash and its finalized canonical receipt. Rollover uses a bound exclusive journal.
review_required: Fill mined before trade summary persisted: LIVE_PARTIAL_TRADE_REQUIRES_REVIEW.
Stale exclusive lock: review ownership and partial state before reuse.
workflow_restart_limits.orchestrator: A failed actor stops its owned stack unless explicit keep-failed debugging was selected. There is no automatic actor-only workflow resume.
workflow_restart_limits.evidence: Preserve journals and receipts; deleting or resetting a journal cannot turn a failed run into a completed proof.

excluded_operational_scripts.start/console/scenario/local: Operational service or deployment entrypoints, not unit validation scripts; owned integration runner provides separate evidence.
excluded_operational_scripts.record/record:classifier/validate: Public evidence or paid model calls prohibited for this validation pass.

raw_evidence.retention: Raw logs, runner ledger and disposable fork directories remain ignored local evidence. This versioned artifact stores commands, counts and hashes; raw logs are not committed.
raw_evidence.runner_diagnostics: An initial Windows cp1252 console printing error occurred after failed attempt 23 was already durably recorded. The runner stdout was switched to UTF-8 and the retained log copied to a portable filename; no failed evidence was discarded.

focused_review_checks.counting: Superseded by the complete E2E22 suite; contributes no additional tests to the aggregate.
